title: Direction Enum
description:
Define a `Direction` enum with members `Up`, `Down`, `Left`, `Right`.

Then implement `opposite(d: Direction): Direction` that returns the opposite direction.

**Example:**
```ts
opposite(Direction.Up)    // Direction.Down
opposite(Direction.Left)  // Direction.Right
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using numeric values directly (e.g. `return d ^ 1`) which is brittle and depends on enum ordering. A switch statement is explicit and safe.
